feedback:
Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is stated for it. The candidate is a single-group geometry change from the best raced design (iteration 5, score 60.49): the outer sensors move from x = ±0.04 to x = ±0.06 at y = 0.04. sensor_size 0.016, kp 7.0, kd 0.2, ki 0.0, base_speed 1.4, the weights [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1] and line_loss last_direction are unchanged. All values are inside the contract ranges, and x = ±0.06 is within ±0.08.

The evidence supports this test. The s-bend progress has been flat at 0.040 across kp 5, 6 and 7 (iterations 0, 3, 4) and did not move when sensor_size went from 0.012 to 0.016 (iteration 5). The gain and dead-band explanations therefore no longer account for the s-bend stall. Oval progress rose with kp (0.12 at kp 6, 0.19 at kp 7, 0.18 at kp 8), and oval max_error has stayed at 0.060 to 0.066 m with one line-loss event per run, so the outer-sensor reach is a reasonable next suspect.

A caution: moving the outer weights outward makes the signal more sensitive at the edges, so steering_oscillation may rise. Iteration 2 (kp 8) reached 0.13 to 0.15 on this, so watch oscillation along with progress.

Read the next race as follows. (a) If s-bend progress rises clearly above 0.04 and max_error falls below about 0.06 m, keep the outer sensors at ±0.06 and lower kp to 6.5 (kd 0.2) to bring steering_oscillation down from the 0.17 seen on the oval at iteration 5. (b) If s-bend progress is still 0.04 with the same max_error, the limit is elsewhere (base_speed or line-loss behaviour at the bend), so the next single-group revision should test line_loss search_right or a lower base_speed (about 1.2). (c) If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6 in a later single-group revision. Report progress, max_error and line_loss_events per track, steering_oscillation, completion_time and rms_error.
requested_changes: If s-bend progress rises above 0.04 and max_error falls below about 0.06 m with the ±0.06 outer sensors, keep the geometry and set kp = 6.5 with kd = 0.2, since kp 8 raised steering_oscillation to 0.13 to 0.15 (iteration 2) and oval oscillation reached 0.174 at kp 7 (iteration 5).

If s-bend progress stays at 0.04 with the same max_error, keep the ±0.06 sensors and set line_loss = search_right, because every run loses the line once (line_loss_events 1.0 in iterations 0 to 5) and the robot leaves the tape at the bend.
If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, set base_speed = 1.6 in a single-group revision, since the 3.0 s limit needs an average speed of about 1.5 m/s.
